'''Puloh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] and part of a group that learned the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]' arts from [[Torgo Tahn]]. He was killed by Tahn during a training session sometime before [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].
